title: Idle-pool strategy adoption discards creditedPrincipal, shorting last withdrawers
description: The story-005 fix made stake/depositFor/_routeDeposit credit IYieldStrategy.deposit's returned creditedPrincipal, but the setYieldStrategy adoption sweep `strategy.deposit(token, idleBalance, address(this))` discards the return value (L215). Adopting a haircutting (market) strategy over a non-empty idle pool leaves poolInfo.totalStaked at full nominal value while strategy.principalOf(this) = idleBalance * (1 - slip). Result: a last-withdrawer FCFS shortfall (silent partial loss of idleBalance * slip, no revert; the underwater guard is blind because it compares strategy-internal totalBalanceOf vs principalOf). The gap becomes skimmable protocol surplus that is unrecoverable by users. Secondary (folded): pre-adoption stakers retain inflated reward weight (distributional only; emission cap not violated). Migration distributes the haircut uniformly (fair), so the loss path is the healthy withdraw path.
impact: Silent partial principal loss on the healthy-withdraw path for the last withdrawers after a haircutting strategy is adopted over a non-empty idle pool. No revert; the underwater guard does not catch it because totalStaked is desynced from strategy.principalOf. The shortfall (idleBalance * slip) becomes protocol surplus unrecoverable by users.
attackPath: Idle pool holds a non-zero idleBalance with poolInfo.totalStaked at full nominal value.
Owner calls setYieldStrategy adopting a haircutting (market/AMM-backed) strategy.
Adoption sweep strategy.deposit(token, idleBalance, address(this)) returns creditedPrincipal = idleBalance * (1 - slip), but the return is discarded at L215.
poolInfo.totalStaked remains at full nominal value while strategy.principalOf(this) = idleBalance * (1 - slip).
Withdrawals proceed FCFS at par; the last withdrawers absorb the idleBalance * slip shortfall (silent, no revert).
The underwater guard compares strategy-internal totalBalanceOf vs principalOf and does not detect the desync, so the gap is not surfaced; it becomes skimmable protocol surplus.
recommendation: Capture the sweep return and reconcile poolInfo.totalStaked to the returned creditedPrincipal, or restrict adoption of a haircutting strategy to totalStaked == 0.
